protocol_amendment.reason: All three independent V6 reviewers required revision before launch-plan design. They found curve derivation before authenticated row admission and resource reservation, one generated density row in the focused controls despite the zero-row boundary, incomplete standalone candidate-list comparison, blocking FIFO admission, an omitted initial-size rejection, late optimizer and transcript rejection, lossy exception receipts, uncapped diagnostics, a verifier-source hash that reopened a path without attesting executed code, and incomplete cache receipts.
changes: Accept only the V7 document schema and reject every V1-V6 schema without row verification.

Authenticate exact row types, row digest, protocol, validity, ordering, registered association, source-owned cap, objective, exact empty frontier, B-derived selected formals and masks, and B-derived transcript lengths before any curve derivation or resource-consuming row semantics.
Construct the frozen static transcript without enumerating points and derive registered canonical curves only after trusted resource reservation.

Open the final input path component with no-follow and nonblocking flags, require a regular file, reject an initial size above 256 MiB before reading, and disclose that parent path components may traverse symlinks.

Reserve source-bounded registered prime candidates, curve draws and hashes, predicate hashes, point enumerations, expansion cells, graph cells, replay nodes, primary nodes, replay and primary caches, retained-model calls, and retained-model cells before row semantics.
Source-enforce producer optimizer, producer full-model, verifier replay-metric, and verifier retained-model replay cache ceilings and authenticate producer cache-entry receipts.

Verify rows sequentially and stop at the first invalid row; preserve prior cap work, the resource reservation, nested diagnostics, and actual_work_complete=false when replay, retained-model, or primary proof raises.
Emit expensive phase status from actual call sites and retain a later failure even after an earlier row or cap passed the same phase.
Bound diagnostic output to 256 items, 65536 total ASCII bytes, and 2048 bytes per item, including bounded missing/extra-key samples.
Freeze the verifier source SHA-256 once at module load, label it diagnostic rather than executed-code attestation, and never reopen the source path while building a report.
Replace the generated Mobius density-row control with a generated factor-base-only control, leaving the frozen p=19 B=4 fixture as the only constructed density row.
Extend the independent frozen-B4 oracle to compare the complete candidate list, every recursive parent pair, and the complete eligible list directly with verifier reconstruction.

Add nonblocking FIFO, sparse oversized-file, pre-authentication zero-work, wrong-objective, nonempty-frontier, oversized-mask, oversized-transcript, second-cap exception, diagnostic-amplification, source-hash-scope, and exact 1/4-versus-999/4000 controls.
Keep every development family-row and canonical run budget at zero.
unchanged_mathematical_boundary: The curve grid, predicates, four null replicates, representative compiler, ordering digest, graph object, cap schedule, five-field objective, matched-null thresholds, positive gate, and negative classification remain unchanged.
Exactness remains finite, TOY-EVIDENCE, and MODEL-BOUND to the fixed compiler and order-ideal construction.
No relation generation, rank, linear algebra, target descent, fixed-curve preprocessing crossover, rho comparison, exponent, deployment, or ECDLP result is in scope.
residual_external_resource_boundary: JSON parser allocation, Python object overhead, allocator bytes, peak RSS, process count, wall time, disk, I/O, and memory bandwidth are not enforced by the in-process verifier and require a future immutable external runner.
The module-load verifier digest is diagnostic only; a future runner must bind the exact commit, command, environment, and immutable input/output paths.
protocol_amendment.required_next_review: Validate and commit one exact V7 snapshot, then obtain fresh independent theory, accounting, and red-team review. Three scoped GO decisions could authorize only a separate hash-complete launch-plan design, not execution.
